annotations.text:
Ritual — the four screens as built.
Colours, type ramp and spacing lifted from Palette.kt / SlabRenderer.kt, not approximated.
The beam falls on today's square on every slab: ornament that is also navigation.

Finding: at 4x2 (320x150dp) there is no room for header + month ruler + grid + tally + action pill.
The renderer currently shrinks the grid to fit, which crushes it.
Proposal: drop the month ruler below ~180dp of height, and the weekday spine below ~220dp.
5x2 shows the opposite case — extra width buys a finer grid, so the ruler fits even at 150dp tall.

Three stances on the same data, not three shades of one.
A is shipped. B inverts the premise — ink on paper, absence as blank page; warm, quiet, no glow to bleed.
C drops the metaphor entirely for a measuring instrument: flat marks, monospace, one signal colour, and it stays legible at any density.
